content: Another concern of this work is that we used computational methods to represent human beings in order to analyze dehumanization on a large scale. However, representing people as sequences of numbers (especially in our vector-based experiments) is inherently dehumanizing them. While we hope that this work will humanize and empower marginalized groups, we acknowledge that it also has this opposite effect.
